subject: spanish

moments.title: Isabel and Fernando marry
moments.body: The marriage joins Castile and Aragon, beginning unified Spanish monarchy.
moments.takeaway: Modern Spain begins with a marriage contract.

moments.title: Columbus reaches the Bahamas
moments.body: Columbus's voyage opens transatlantic colonisation. His diary records Tainos as 'gentle and peaceful'.
moments.takeaway: Colonisation's earliest documents preserve indigenous voices to the extent the colonisers chose to record them.

moments.title: Treaty of Tordesillas
moments.body: A papal-mediated line divides the non-European world between two Iberian powers.
moments.takeaway: Empire was divided on paper before being claimed on land.

now.title: 1492 today
now.body: Hispanidad Day (12 October) is a Spanish national holiday, increasingly contested in the Americas as 'Indigenous Resistance Day'.

reflection: The Atlantic became Spanish before any other European country crossed it.
